mobbin:3ca22a69-3cb8-4993-9cbd-f07f63757.summary: From a Week-by-Area grid, the manager opens Auto, chooses Auto-build shift structure, sets lengths/requirements/start times, runs Build shifts through a progress modal, and lands on a grid with EMPTY/OPEN slots plus a warning on one shift.
steps: Week by Area — filled grid + Open + footer status
Auto menu — regular hours / build structure / fill empty
Auto Build modal — lengths, prior schedules, start times
Result grid — EMPTY/OPEN cards + warning triangle
steal: Auto menu splits three jobs: regular hours, build structure, fill empty (step 2) — cheap adoption without one opaque AI button.
Auto Build params: ordered shift lengths, requirements from previous schedules, start-at-:00 constraint (step 3).
Footer status counts empty/published/open/warnings while generation runs (steps 1, 4–5).
Post-build EMPTY cards vs OPEN badge vs red warning triangle on a cell (step 5).
avoid: Trivia/fact filler during Auto Build progress (step 4) — wastes coordinator attention; use schedule preview instead.
mobbin:3ca22a69-3cb8-4993-9cbd-f07f63757.fit: Maps to flexi auto-generate N sessions from prior demand: keep structure-then-fill + EMPTY/OPEN/warning states; extend LearningSpace flexi, not full AI labor planning.

mobbin:6a3f27e2-9c1c-4dbd-a527-d26366020.summary: Manager starts from an empty Week-by-Area resource grid with people sidebar and per-cell +, drafts unpublished grey shifts, then publishes them to green cards with an Open shift and zero warnings.
steps: Empty Week by Area — Areas rows + cell + + Auto/Copy
Draft grid — grey unpublished cards + Publish 12 shifts
Published grid — green cards + OPEN badge + legend
steal: Week by Area: rows = role/area, columns = days, every empty cell has + (steps 1–3).
People sidebar shows Open shifts + per-person hours/cost (steps 1–3).
Explicit draft→Publish: grey unpublished then green published (steps 2–3).
mobbin:6a3f27e2-9c1c-4dbd-a527-d26366020.fit: Closest resource-by-room pattern for Essentials: Areas ≈ rooms/stations; keep draft/publish + open slots; drop labor-cost if unused.

mobbin:33ce7034-4170-4403-be14-e3b58184a.summary: Employee opens Me calendar then Schedule, selects their shift, chooses Can't work → Swap shift, picks a teammate's shift with a message, sends the request, and sees toast plus SWAP/OPEN badges on the grid.
steps: Me calendar — week days + Available Shifts
Week by Area — published + OPEN Admin slot
Shift popover — Sam Lee details + Can't work
Can't work menu — Offer shift / Swap shift
Swap modal — search teammates, checkbox, Send (0)
Swap modal — Alex selected + message + Send (1)
Grid + toast — Shift swap request sent
Grid — SWAP and OPEN badges on cards
steal: Can't work splits Offer vs Swap (step 4) — claim pool vs peer trade.
Swap modal: your shift summary, teammate search, selectable peer shifts, default message, Send count (steps 5–6).
Grid badges LOCKED / OPEN / SWAP after request (steps 7–8).
Me calendar shows who is Scheduled this day via avatars (step 1).
avoid: Allowing Admin↔Manager swap without eligibility gate (steps 5–6) — in sim, faculty/learner roles must stay constrained.
mobbin:33ce7034-4170-4403-be14-e3b58184a.fit: Pattern for learner/faculty self-serve swap with coordinator visibility via SWAP badge; pair with approval before calendar commits.
